Plastic recycling codes (Resin Identification Codes 1 to 7) are marked on plastic items to facilitate sorting and recycling. 

| Code | Polymer Name | Common Applications | 
| :--- | :--- | :--- | 
| **1** | PETE / PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate) | Soft drink bottles, water bottles, peanut butter jars. | 
| **2** | HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) | Milk jugs, detergent bottles, shampoo bottles, grocery bags. | 
| **3** | PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride) | Pipes, wire insulation, medical tubing, vinyl flooring. | 
| **4** | LDPE (Low-Density Polyethylene) | Squeezable bottles, bread bags, clothing wraps, garbage bags. | 
| **5** | PP (Polypropylene) | Yogurt containers, bottle caps, straws, microwaveable containers. | 
| **6** | PS (Polystyrene) | Disposable coffee cups, styrofoam packaging, egg cartons, cutlery. | 
| **7** | Other (Polycarbonate, Acrylic, PLA, Nylon) | Baby bottles, large water cooler jugs, multi-layer plastics, compact discs. |
proTip: Remember that Codes 1 and 2 are the most widely and easily recycled plastics globally, whereas Codes 6 and 7 are difficult to process.
